'''Daniel Sigrist''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 DragonCon Open]] on 30 June 2000 with EBO, according to Brandon Baity's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d967">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treportd967/ lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treport], DeckTech (Brandon "Lord Jaden" Baity, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-lordjaden-s-dragoncon-sw-open-treportd967/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
